
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19106110" title="发布于 2025-09-22 21:40">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">vite7-webos网页版os管理|Vue3+Vite7+ArcoDesign搭建pc端os后台系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(149, 19, 235, 1)">最新版研发<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 255, 1)">Vite7+Vue3+Pinia3+Arco</span>仿<strong>macos/windows</strong>网页版<strong>webos</strong>管理系统。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>vite7-webos</strong>原创基于<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">vite7.1+vue3.5+pinia3+arco-design+echarts</span>从0-1搭建pc网页版os式管理系统模板。支持<strong>macos+windows</strong>两种桌面布局风格、<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">自定义桌面栅格模板、可拖拽栅格菜单/dock菜单</span>等功能。</span></p>
<p><img alt="002360截图20250921094813196" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921212456742-568895102.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>技术栈</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：VScode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">技术框架：vite7.1.2+vue3.5.18+vue-router4.5.1+pinia3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">组件库：arco-design^2.57.0 (字节桌面版vue3组件库)</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia^3.0.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">图表插件：echarts^6.0.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">拖拽组件：sortablejs^1.15.6</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">模拟数据：mockjs^1.1.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">样式编译：sass^1.92.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">构建工具：vite^7.1.2</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921213900040-2135282099.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921214000752-1803867474.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921214048697-1921202310.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目框架目录</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">使用最新前端构建工具&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">vite7</span>&nbsp;搭建项目，采用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">vue3 setup</span>&nbsp;语法糖开发页面。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20250921214758954" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921214830135-266445698.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<h3><em>vite7-vue3-webos网页os系统已经更新到我的原创作品集。</em></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><a href="https://mall.bilibili.com/neul-next/detailuniversal/detail.html?isMerchant=1&amp;page=detailuniversal_detail&amp;saleType=10&amp;itemsId=11190512&amp;loadingShow=1&amp;noTitleBar=1&amp;msource=merchant_share" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">vite7+vue3+arco-design仿macOS网页版os管理系统</a></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="p5" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921215302598-1174297486.gif" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>项目入口配置main.js</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createApp } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'./style.scss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App.vue'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入arco.design组件库</span>
import ArcoDesign from '@arco-design/web-vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'@arco-design/web-vue/dist/arco.css'
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 额外引入图标库</span>
import ArcoIcon from '@arco-design/web-vue/es/icon'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import VEPlus from </span>'ve-plus'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'ve-plus/dist/ve-plus.css'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入路由及状态管理</span>
import Router from './router'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import Pinia from </span>'./pinia'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

createApp(App)
.use(ArcoDesign)
.use(ArcoIcon)
.use(VEPlus)
.use(Router)
.use(Pinia)
.mount(</span>'#app')</pre>
</div>

<h3>桌面布局结构</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">支持<strong>macos</strong>和<strong>windows</strong>两种桌面布局风格。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921220258539-1761515996.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">setup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import { appState } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/pinia/modules/app</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>

  <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入布局模板</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  import MacosLayout from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">./template/macos.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import WindowsLayout from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">./template/windows.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  const appstate </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> appState()

  const DeskLayout </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    macos: MacosLayout,
    windows: WindowsLayout
  }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__container desktop flexbox flex-alignc flex-justifyc"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'--themeSkin': appstate.config.skin}"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    @contextmenu.prevent
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">component </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">:is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="DeskLayout[appstate.config.layout]"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>

<h3>vue3-webos桌面栅格模板</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921222655236-561615585.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921223000761-1967094127.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921223120596-476540336.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义桌面图标变量</span>
const deskVariable =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref({
  </span>'--icon-radius': '10px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 圆角</span>
  '--icon-size': '60px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图标尺寸(设置rpx自定义手机设备)</span>
  '--icon-gap-col': '30px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 水平间距</span>
  '--icon-gap-row': '30px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 垂直间距</span>
  '--icon-labelSize': '12px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签文字大小</span>
  '--icon-labelColor': '#fff', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签颜色</span>
  '--icon-fit': 'contain', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图标自适应模式</span>
})</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>桌面菜单配置参数</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * ====== desk菜单配置项 ======
 * label 图标标题
 * imgico 图标(本地或网络图片) 支持Arco Design内置图标或自定义iconfont图标
 * path 跳转路由页面
 * link 跳转外部链接
 * hideLabel 是否隐藏图标标题
 * filter 是否禁用拖拽
 * background 自定义图标背景色
 * color 自定义图标颜色
 * size 栅格磁贴布局(16种) 1x1 ... 12x12
 * padding 内边距
 * onClick 点击图标回调函数
 * children 二级菜单
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921223540693-1724561856.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">配置<strong>children</strong>参数，支持弹窗显示二级菜单。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921223644794-1374380836.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>vue3-webos自定义dock菜单</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921224320192-1682296970.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250921224429336-1515139279.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__macos-dock"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__dock-wrap"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="appstate.config.dock||'compact'"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="(data, key) in dockMenu"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :key</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="key"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__dock-group"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="(item, index) in data?.list"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :key</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="index"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__dock-item"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> @click</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleClickDock(item)"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">span </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="item.label"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="label"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>{{item.label}}<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">span</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 二级菜单 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-trigger </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isArray(item?.children)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> trigger</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="click"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 二级缩略图 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="thumb"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__dock-thumbmenu"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                ...
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">#content</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 二级弹窗菜单 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__dock-thumbpopup"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-scrollbar </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="overflow: auto; margin-top: 10px; height: 210px;"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                  ...
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-scrollbar</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-trigger</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-else class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="imgico"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'color': item.color}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isImg(item.imgico)"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">img </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">:src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="item.imgico"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">component </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isObject(item.imgico)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ico"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="item.imgico"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-else class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ico elec-icon"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="item.imgico"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
